applicableAreas: Existing utility poles at property boundaries
findings.comment: Existing utility poles are shown on plans but down guy wires and anchors are not depicted with specific notation or symbols identifying guy wire locations and anchor points. Cannot verify that all existing guy wire support infrastructure has been documented.

applicableAreas: Section views and building elevations where proposed structures may be in proximity to existing overhead facilities
findings.comment: Required profile views or building elevations showing existing overhead electric facilities with height dimensions and clearance envelopes are not evident. Cannot verify that proper vertical clearances and conductor height information are documented.

Proposed electrical facilities shown on Sheet 21 lack critical coordination details. Clearance envelopes, setup area dimensions (required 20' × 35' per UCM § 1.3.16), disconnect switch locations, and staging areas for transformer pads are not depicted. Transformer pad locations are shown but without the required access and clear zone delineations.

Street lighting layout, poles, and conduit connections are not clearly shown on the electrical or utility plans provided. Cannot verify whether street lighting is proposed or whether it has been documented with adequate detail.

Austin Energy Standard Notes are not provided on any sheet of the plan set. Neither Sheet 1 (Cover), Sheet 3 (General Notes), nor Sheet 21 (Electrical Design Plan) contain AE Standard Notes required by UCM § 1.16.0.

No note is provided on the electrical design plan or any coordinated sheet explicitly stating that all electric infrastructure (existing and proposed) is shown on the plans, including any exceptions that require Austin Energy pre-approval.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations (3 pads identified on Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Electrical design plan does not include required measurements and coordination details. Missing: (1) clearance measurements from transformers to structures and vegetation, (2) setup area dimensions (20' × 35' horizontal, 35' vertical clearance required per UCM § 1.3.16), (3) disconnect switch location relative to transformer, (4) bollard or protective details, (5) truck access requirements and turning radii for maintenance vehicles.

applicableAreas: Existing electric easements on multiple plan sheets
findings.comment: Existing electric easements are shown on Sheet 2 (Plat) and Sheet 9 (Site Plan), but are not consistently shown across all required plan sheets. Sheet 21 (Electrical Design Plan) does not clearly delineate easement boundaries or designate whether they are aerial or underground. Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show easement boundaries in relation to proposed plantings.

Plans do not explicitly distinguish between aerial electric easements (for overhead facilities with vertical clearance requirements) and underground electric easements (for subsurface facilities with horizontal clearances). Easements on Sheet 2 and Sheet 9 are labeled generically as '5' Elec. Easement' and '5' Elec. & Tele. Easement' without aerial/underground designation.

Recording information (document number, volume/page, or plat reference) is not consistently provided for all existing electric easements on the plans. While some easements reference volume/page (e.g., 'Vol. 73, Pg. 76'), others lack complete recording information.

Critical missing easements: The recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior area) and the City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner area) are not depicted on the submitted site plan or plat (Sheet 2). Per facts.md, these easements are perpetual, recorded in Travis County, and must be shown before approval. Submitted plans are inconsistent with recorded property instruments.

Applicability of new electric easement requirement cannot be fully determined from available plans. Sheet 3 Release Note #5 states 'Additional electric easements may be required at a later date,' but no proposed easements are shown on the electrical design plan. Cannot verify whether easements are required or properly depicted.

Sheet 2 displays the historical 1975 Mecey Subdivision plat. This plat does not show the modern easements that must be recorded as part of this site plan approval, particularly the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137) which are critical to this property. If a new plat is being recorded with this site plan, it must include all easements.

applicableAreas: Multiple utility plan sheets including electrical, landscape, and grading plans
findings.comment: Electric facilities are not shown on all required plan sheets with consistent detail and coordination. Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan) shows detailed routing, transformers, and conduits. Sheet 9 (Site Plan) shows general transformer location and overhead lines but lacks detail. Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show transformer locations, resulting in lack of coordination with landscaping in critical clearance areas.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and surrounding landscape areas
findings.comment: Tree locations and electrical transformer infrastructure are not properly coordinated across plan sheets. Specifically, Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) shows trees planted directly adjacent to transformer locations identified on Sheet 21. Per UCM § 1.3.16, transformers require 20' × 35' setup areas with 35' vertical clearance, but landscape plan shows large canopy trees within these required clear zones.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan adjacent to three transformer locations
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows landscaping (trees, shrubs) planted within required transformer staging areas. Three pad-mounted transformers are identified on Sheet 21, and each requires a minimum 20' × 35' horizontal clear zone with 35' vertical clearance. Landscape symbols on Sheet 31 indicate plantings (labeled as SY, M, and other designations) in the vicinity of these transformer locations.

Cannot verify whether proposed AE infrastructure improvements shown on plans comply with accessibility standards. Transformers and conduit routing are shown but without dimensions for equipment pad access, door opening clearances, or ADA-compliant approaches required by UCM § 1.16.0.

Projected electrical load required for electric service is not shown anywhere on the electrical design plan or supporting documents. Sheet 21 shows transformer locations and routing but does not specify the total electrical demand (in kW or kVA) for the 39-unit townhome development.

Cannot verify that the plat being recorded contains the required Austin Energy note regarding AE right to prune/remove trees and obstructions in electric easements. Sheet 2 shows a historical 1975 plat; if a new plat is being recorded, required AE notes must be verified.

Cannot verify that the plat contains required note stating owner obligation to provide additional easements and access for overhead/underground electric facilities. If a new plat is being recorded, this required AE note must be present.

applicableAreas: Plat document with overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Cannot verify presence of required plat note regarding owner responsibility for erosion control, revegetation, tree protection, and tree pruning/removal within 10 feet of overhead facilities centerline. Plans show overhead electric lines but plat note requirement cannot be verified from submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Plat document with overhead power lines
findings.comment: Cannot verify presence of required plat note regarding owner responsibility for maintaining NESC/NEC/OSHA/City clearances when working near overhead power lines. Plans show overhead electric infrastructure but plat note requirement cannot be verified.

Meter locations are shown on Sheet 21 (electrical plan) at specific building walls, but architectural elevations or detailed drawings do not verify that meters are not placed on/under porches, stairways, overhangs >72 inches, or within 3-foot radius of gas infrastructure. Additionally, 100-year flood elevation requirement (minimum 1 foot above flood level) cannot be verified from available documents.

applicableAreas: Customer facility clearances from AE primary voltage facilities
findings.comment: No survey showing proximities of customer facilities to existing AE primary voltage facilities is provided. Required survey per AE Design coordination cannot be verified from submitted electrical design plan.

applicableAreas: Property proximity to existing Austin Energy infrastructure
findings.comment: Existing Austin Energy infrastructure is visible on plans (overhead lines, poles, service connections at western boundary). Cannot verify from submitted documents whether formal AE approval has been obtained for the development when property is within 200 feet of existing AE infrastructure per LDC § 25-4-200(B).
